name: China Communications Construction Company Limited
summary: China Communications Construction Company Limited (CCCC), alongside its various subsidiaries, is a prominent entity primarily focused on infrastructure development, engineering design, and dredging operations. Its comprehensive construction portfolio encompasses a wide range of significant projects. These include transportation networks like roads, bridges, railways, and urban rail transit systems; vital marine infrastructure such as ports, waterways, and large-scale land reclamation; as well as municipal infrastructure, river basin management, and environmental protection initiatives. Beyond physical construction, CCCC delivers extensive infrastructure design services. These services span consulting, planning, feasibility studies, detailed survey and engineering design, technical research, project management, and supervision, often culminating in general project contracting and the development of industry standards and codes. The company's dredging expertise covers infrastructure development, ongoing maintenance, and environmental remediation, alongside large-scale land reclamation and watershed management. It also provides crucial support for related dredging and land reclamation ventures. Diversifying its business, CCCC is also involved in the manufacturing of road construction machinery. Its commercial activities include trading motor vehicle spare parts and various types of machinery, as well as the design and maintenance of specialized port equipment. Furthermore, it deals in construction materials and equipment, and offers financial services such as fund management and financial leasing. With a significant global presence, the company conducts operations across Mainland China, Australia, Hong Kong, Africa, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Established in 2006 and headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China, China Communications Construction Company Limited operates as a key subsidiary of the larger China Communications Construction Group (Ltd.).
